conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; FLTR opens the FILTER page of track BD; TRK is held while encoder 4 (FRQ) turns down from 127 to 75; then TRK + the SD pad selects SD. The same plan on stock 1.74 gives identical frames up to that point; on SD's FILTER page stock still shows the curve fully open, and the frames differ only in the filter curve (x 84-162, y 117-134).
